description: The Spring Boot module that exposes operational endpoints such as health and metrics under /actuator.
The include and exclude lists that decide which Actuator endpoints are reachable over HTTP, with only health exposed by default.
A named selection of health indicators served under its own path, such as the liveness and readiness groups.
The Micrometer object injected into beans to create counters, gauges and timers.
The number of distinct values a metric tag can take, which must stay small because each value creates a new series.
A trace is the path of one request across operations and services, made of spans that share a trace ID.
An identifier stored in the logging context and returned to the client so the logs of one request can be found together.
Writing each log event as JSON, in a format such as ecs, so fields like the MDC keys can be searched.
